1. (Currently amended) A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein __the first sensor comprises force sensing material having a conductance that varies based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell__; and __a processor configured to receive an output signal from the first sensor and generate a processor output signal based on the output signal__.

2. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising an adhesive layer positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the adhesive layer is configured to distribute forces from the first battery cell to the first sensor__.

3. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein at least a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned adjacent at least a portion the first sensor in a plane between the first battery cell and the enclosure.

4. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 3, wherein the adhesive layer extends around at least a portion of the first sensor in the plane.

5. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein a portion of the first sensor extends through a gap in the adhesive layer towards an edge of the first battery cell.

6. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 2, wherein a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned between the first sensor and one of the first battery cell and the enclosure.

7. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a deformable element positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure, __and wherein the deformable element is configured to transmit forces from the first battery cell to the first sensor__.

8. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein: the enclosure comprises an enclosure portion of protective film; the first sensor is positioned between first battery cell and the enclosure portion; __and the protective film is configured to allow force transmission to the first sensor__.

9. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 8, wherein the protective film is a polyester film __having a thickness configured to facilitate force sensing__.

10. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein: the enclosure comprises a plastic case portion; the first sensor is positioned between first battery cell and the plastic case portion; __and the plastic case portion is configured to allow force transmission to the first sensor__.

11. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, __and wherein the first sensor is configured to detect forces resulting from stacking pressure between the first battery cell and the second battery cell__.

12. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising an adhesive layer between the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

13. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein at least a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned adjacent at least a portion the first sensor in a plane between the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

14. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 13, wherein the adhesive layer extends around at least a portion of the first sensor in the plane.

15. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein a portion of the first sensor extends through a gap in the adhesive layer towards an edge of the first battery cell.

16. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 12, wherein a portion of the adhesive layer is positioned between the first sensor and one of the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

17. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell; a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, __wherein the first sensor and the second sensor each comprise force sensing material having conductance that varies based on forces influencing their respective battery cells__.

18. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 17 further comprising a processor configured to: receive a first sensor output signal from the first sensor; receive a second sensor output signal from the second sensor; conduct an evaluation based at least on the received output signals; and generate at least one processor output signal based on the evaluation, __wherein the processor is configured to independently monitor and respond to forces influencing the first battery cell and the third battery cell__.

19. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 18, wherein the processor is further configured to alter an operation of the third battery cell independently from an operation of the first battery cell based on the at least one processor output signal, __wherein the alteration is based on force conditions detected by the second sensor__.

20. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 18, wherein the processor is further configured to turn off the third battery cell and to maintain operation of the first battery cell based on the at least one processor output signal, __wherein the decision to turn off the third battery cell is based on force levels detected by the second sensor exceeding a threshold__.

21. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material.

22. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 21, wherein the force sensing material comprises at least one variable electrical conductor.

23. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 22, wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor has a first level of electrical conductance when the at least one variable electrical conductor is quiescent, and wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor has a second level of conductance when a mechanical stress is applied to the at least one variable electrical conductor.

24. (Previously presented) The battery assembly of claim 22, wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor is a quantum tunneling composite.

25. (Currently amended) The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a contact sensor __configured to detect mechanical contact resulting from forces influencing the first battery cell__.
